agentEnvelopeComparison.caveat: The five deterministic synthetic queries measure response-envelope bytes, not provider-billed tokens or verified task completion. Impact uses a complete connected behavioral core. Query returns the top three ranked nodes and relationships between them unless nodeLimit explicitly requests a larger result. Both operations treat the token budget as a ceiling rather than refilling it. Agent mode renders the same selected graph as concise readable lines; dual and text retain structured compatibility.

caveat: Five synthetic queries and repeated short-answer pilots are not a powered task-quality or provider-cost study. Codex CLI has large fixed scaffolding; one text call had a different cached-input count. Do not present byte-derived estimates or this pilot as release-wide savings.
